trial_title: Efficacy of Gynodian® Depot in Women With Impaired Well-being
brief_summary: The typical menopausal symptoms that are associated with a variety of physical and psychological changes (e.g. nervousness, anxiety, and depression) and also with impaired sexual interest and enjoyment are caused by a lack of estrogen, a female sex hormone produced inside the body. eligibility_table.justification: The patient can provide written informed consent.

eligibility_table.criterion: Postmenopausal status (amenorrhea for at least 12 months)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is male and does not have a history of amenorrhea.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced amenorrhea for at least 12 consecutive months?

eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 51 years old, which falls within the 45-65 years age range.

eligibility_table.criterion: Application of estrogen or cyclic estrogen/progestin preparation other than the study medication for at least 6 months prior to Visit 1
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information on the application of estrogen or cyclic estrogen/progestin preparation.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient used any estrogen or cyclic estrogen/progestin preparation for at least 6 months prior to Visit 1?

eligibility_table.criterion: Relevant impairment of well-being and mood inspite of estrogen therapy (confirmed by questionnaire scores)
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information on the patient's well-being and mood in relation to estrogen therapy.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a relevant impairment of well-being and mood as indicated by a score of ≥10 on the validated questionnaire despite ongoing estrogen therapy?

eligibility_table.justification: The patient's BMI is not provided, but assuming it is below 33 kg/m2 based on typical profiles.

eligibility_table.criterion: Uterine bleeding of unknown etiology within the last 2 years
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information on uterine bleeding history.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced any episodes of uterine bleeding of unknown etiology within the last 2 years?

eligibility_table.criterion: Previous or existing or suspected carcinoma of the breast
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information on any previous or existing carcinoma of the breast.

eligibility_table.justification: There is no information on any malignant disease in the last 5 years.
